SINGAPORE VPS HOSTING
A Singapore VPS built for Asia-Pacific

Serve users across Southeast Asia, India, Australia, and East Asia from a Singapore datacenter — full-root NVMe servers with a dedicated IP and DDoS, from $6.49/mo.

Deploy now

See pricing

If your users are in Asia-Pacific, geography is performance. A request from Jakarta, Manila, Sydney, or Mumbai that has to cross the Pacific to a US datacenter and back pays for it in every page load, API call, and game tick. Hosting close to your audience is the single biggest latency win you can buy.

Nxeon runs a datacenter in Singapore — one of the best-connected network hubs in the region, sitting on the submarine cable routes that link Southeast Asia, South Asia, Oceania, and East Asia. From there, round-trips to major APAC population centres stay low, which is exactly what interactive apps, real-time services, and game servers need.

It's the same full-root NVMe platform everywhere else: enterprise NVMe on a self-healing ZFS mirror, a dedicated IPv4, always-on DDoS protection, daily backups, and one-click deploys in about 47 seconds — now sitting where your Asia-Pacific traffic actually is.

Low latency across the region

Enterprise NVMe on ZFS

Fast, consistent storage on enterprise NVMe over a self-healing ZFS mirror — low network latency paired with low disk latency.

Dedicated IPv4 + DDoS included

Caught and fixed a real bug along the way: the countdown was frozen at 47 because a `useRef` mount-guard interacted badly with React 18 StrictMode's dev double-invoke, silently killing the interval. Verified in-browser that it now actually reaches LIVE with zero console errors.
